variation: Bodyweight bent-knee floor crunch, hands lightly behind head.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter; head left, feet right, abdomen visible.
anchors: Tailbone and lower back on floor
catalogueNote: Do not visually suggest hip flexors should drive the curl despite catalogue secondary-muscle listing.

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Lie back with knees bent and hands lightly behind head.
frames.state: Supine, feet planted; hands support head without pulling; elbows comfortably open.

frames.label: Begin curl
frames.cue: Brace your abs and start lifting your shoulder blades.
frames.state: Small upper-spine curl, head supported in alignment.

frames.label: Continue curl
frames.cue: Bring your ribs towards your pelvis without neck pulling.
frames.state: Shoulder blades rise further; low back and tailbone remain down.

frames.label: Top crunch
frames.cue: Pause with shoulder blades raised and feet planted.
frames.state: Modest upper-back lift; never a sit-up or hip hinge.

frames.label: Finish lowering
frames.cue: Return your shoulders gently towards the floor.
frames.state: Same as 2 while lowering; loop returns to floor.
